summary: Czech family foundry (150 staff, EUR 8.3 M), we are 2.4 % of its turnover and growing 30 %. It calls Hollerau an important reference customer and opened a new moulding line (Apr 2026), which may mean spare capacity. Holds only 25 % of Volute casing HI 80-250; 70180 has 75 % (at a higher 654.52). Historically gives way fully (kept share below 0). Quality slipping: ppm 5682, red Q3. Push hard with volume as the carrot.
notes: New moulding line may mean spare capacity; it values Hollerau as a reference. Fears losing the 25 % share to 70180. Only a generic 10-day payment e-mail; we pay 5.5 days late on average. No should-cost for its part.
